core.title: 13 Inch by 9 Inch Classic Magazine Rack, Deltana 98C2020

text.description_html:
Deltana 98C2020, Classic Wall Mounted Magazine Rack

A solid brass magazine rack, it features a classic steeped rose that will look great in any traditional decor. Made by Deltana with the attention to quality for which they are known, it is available in either oil rubbed bronze, polished chrome, polished nickel, and satin nickel finishes. Not only good for the bathroom, it is perfect for waiting rooms of all kinds and for the kid's bedroom to hold their favorite books.

Shop more of the Deltana 98C Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the 98C Solid Brass Classic 13" x 9" Magazine Rack With Solid Brass Steeped Rose:

  • Long Bar Length Center to Center: 10-3/8"
  • Short Bar Length Center to Center: 5-1/4"
  • Overall Long Bar Length: 13"
  • Overall Short Bar Length: 6-1/8"
  • Overall Height: 8-3/4"
  • Overall Projection: 3-1/8"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Deltana 98C2020 13" x 9" Magazine Rack Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 magazine rack, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
